# Lenz 0.0.21 beta

This release brings a new branch picker to Lenz Code and refines folder trust (PRs #60, #61, #62).

- Lenz Code's branch picker groups rows into sections with their sizes: the current branch first, then Favorites, Local, Remote, Tags and Worktrees. Long sections show their first rows and **Show N more…**.
- Branches sharing a folder (`feature/…`) gather under a folder row that Enter or → opens and ← closes; a filter lists every match by its whole name.
- **Add to Favorites** in a row's actions keeps a branch at the top, per repository and shared by its worktrees.
- Each local branch shows how far it is from its upstream (`↑2 ↓1`, or `gone`), read after the lists from the last fetch; Lenz Code never fetches.
- The Folder Trust dialog's **Stay Restricted** (and so Enter or Escape) keeps only that folder restricted: folders inside it that you trusted stay trusted. **Stop Trusting Project Tools in This Folder** still restricts them too.
- Lenz Code no longer warns when language servers together use more than 2 GiB; each server's memory stays in its status.

## Validation

The release commit passes the full local Linux gate and `scripts/perf-check.sh`. Native macOS interaction remains unverified. Native package build/signature and CLI checks are separate from interactive validation. macOS packages are ad-hoc signed.

Keep all five executables together. Verify the matching `.sha256` sidecar before installation.

[Changes since 0.0.20](https://github.com/aantoniadis/lenz/compare/v0.0.20...v0.0.21).
